---
title: "Add a new lecture series"
sidebar: docs
---

Use this checklist whenever you start another course (e.g. Generative AI foundations, a CV series, etc.). The site is designed so **each series is a folder + a sidebar block**.

## 1. Copy the template

```powershell
Copy-Item -Recurse templates\new-course courses\SERIES_ID
```

Replace `SERIES_ID` with a short slug, e.g. `mfgenai`, `dl-specialization`.

## 2. Edit the course home page

Open `courses/SERIES_ID/index.qmd`:

- Set `title`, instructor, links
- Set YAML `sidebar: SERIES_ID` (must match step 3)

## 3. Register navigation in `_quarto.yml`

**A. Navbar → Courses menu** — uncomment / add:

```yaml
- text: Your Series Title
  href: courses/SERIES_ID/index.qmd
```

**B. New sidebar** — copy the commented `SERIES_ID` block and fill lecture paths:

```yaml
- id: SERIES_ID
  title: "Short Name"
  style: docked
  search: true
  contents:
    - courses/SERIES_ID/index.qmd
    - section: "Lectures"
      contents:
        - courses/SERIES_ID/lectures/01-.../notes.qmd
    - courses/SERIES_ID/references.qmd
```

**C. Courses index table** — add a row in `courses/index.qmd` and optionally on the home page.

## 4. Add lectures as you go

For each lecture:

```text
courses/SERIES_ID/lectures/NN-short-slug/
  notes.qmd          # reading notes
  tutorial.ipynb     # optional beginner notebook
  self-check-answers.qmd
```

Every page should include:

```yaml
sidebar: SERIES_ID
```

Then append the new files under that sidebar’s `contents` in `_quarto.yml`.

## 5. Preview

```powershell
quarto preview
```

## Naming tips

| Good `SERIES_ID` | Avoid |
|------------------|--------|
| `mfml`, `mfgenai`, `cs231n` | spaces, capitals, long titles |
| Stable forever | renaming later breaks URLs |
